<section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-fd65fe3 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="fd65fe3" data-element_type="section">
<div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default">
<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-100 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-0322bfc" data-id="0322bfc" data-element_type="column">
<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-467f5ed elementor-widget elementor-widget-toggle" data-id="467f5ed" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="toggle.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<div class="elementor-toggle">
<div class="elementor-toggle-item">
<div id="elementor-tab-title-7391" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="1" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-7391" aria-expanded="false"> <span class="elementor-toggle-icon elementor-toggle-icon-left" aria-hidden="true"> <span class="elementor-toggle-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-caret-right"></i></span> <span class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened"><i class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened fas fa-caret-up"></i></span> </span> <a class="elementor-toggle-title" tabindex="0">Read more about the accommodation</a></div><div id="elementor-tab-content-7391" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="1" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-7391"><p>The week tours start by Saturday dinner (check-in after 4 PM) and end by Saturday breakfast (check-out before 11 AM). </p><p>Fagerheim snowkiting base is a set of newly renovated Norwegian apartments. Each apartment has two floors, accommodates 4 people, and has everything you need – a living room with fireplace and amazing views of the plateau, 2 double bedrooms, bathroom &amp; toilet, kitchen, and storage. 3 apartments are “connected” together via an open wall in the living room and create a spacious living area for up to 12 people (ideal for bigger friendly groups). The apartments are located at a place with 5G internet coverage. Unlimited internet is available for poor remote workers, but we don&#8217;t like to see it!</p><p>Fagerheim is the right place, it won&#8217;t be far anywhere: 0 minutes walk to the closest snowkite spot (Fagerheim), 10 minutes by car to Haugastøl (closest train station), 15 minutes by car maximum to any snowkite spot on the plateau, 20 minutes by car to the closest store and gas station (Ustaoset).</p></div></div></div></div></div><section class="elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-e5498ed elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="e5498ed" data-element_type="section">

<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <h3 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Your Benefits When Kiting With Upwind</h3></div></div></div></div></div></section>
<section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-29d09de elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="29d09de" data-element_type="section">

<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <h3 class="elementor-headline"> <span class="elementor-headline-dynamic-wrapper elementor-headline-text-wrapper"> <span class="elementor-headline-dynamic-text elementor-headline-text-active">Snowkiting Paradise</span> </span> <span class="elementor-headline-plain-text elementor-headline-text-wrapper"> - Norway Snowkite base at Fagerheim </span> </h3></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-64bc744 elementor-arrows-position-inside elementor-pagination-position-outside elementor-widget elementor-widget-image-carousel" data-id="64bc744" data-element_type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;slides_to_show_mobile&quot;:&quot;1&quot;,&quot;lazyload&quot;:&quot;yes&quot;,&quot;navigation&quot;:&quot;both&quot;,&quot;autoplay&quot;:&quot;yes&quot;,&quot;pause_on_hover&quot;:&quot;yes&quot;,&quot;pause_on_interaction&quot;:&quot;yes&quot;,&quot;autoplay_speed&quot;:5000,&quot;infinite&quot;:&quot;yes&quot;,&quot;speed&quot;:500,&quot;image_spacing_custom&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:20,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;image_spacing_custom_tablet&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]}}" data-widget_type="image-carousel.default">

No trees or wires wide far. Stay with members of Jan Simek’s team, the Long Distance Kiting VAKE 2019 world champion!</figcaption></figure></div><div class="swiper-slide" role="group" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="4 of 5"><figure class="swiper-slide-inner"><img class="swiper-slide-image swiper-lazy" data-src="https://dagalifjellpark.no/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/mat_for_grupper_Dagali_Fjellpark_3_resize_resize-400x300.jpg" alt="Meals for groups - Dagali Fjellpark."/><div class="swiper-lazy-preloader"></div><figcaption class="elementor-image-carousel-caption">Full board is included. <section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-d0f59b7 elementor-hidden-desktop elementor-hidden-tablet elementor-hidden-mobile elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="d0f59b7" data-element_type="section">
<div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default">
<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-97fbb66" data-id="97fbb66" data-element_type="column">
<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-87e6460 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="87e6460" data-element_type="widget" id="place" data-widget_type="heading.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <h4 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">The best place for snowkiting</h4></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-5854312 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="5854312" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <p>Huge ridable area, stable wind and really looong winter season. Giant lakes, gradual hills, lots of snow. No trees or wires wide far. Just whistling wind, you &#8230; and kite!</p><p>Fagerheim is kind of a strategic location. Being located by the main road at the Hardangervidda plateau, you can kite right in front of your door or reach any spot on the plateau within 15-minute drive. If you are looking for a beginner conditions and flat area or advanced terrains with steep hills and valleys of powder, both are just a stone’s throw from our base.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-8c17e15" data-id="8c17e15" data-element_type="column">
<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-820e3ca elementor-widget elementor-widget-image" data-id="820e3ca" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="image.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <img onload="Wpfcll.r(this,true);" src="https://dagalifjellpark.no/wp-content/plugins/wp-fastest-cache-premium/pro/images/blank.gif" decoding="async" width="600" height="400" data-wpfc-original-src="https://dagalifjellpark.no/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Fagerheim32_resize_resize.jpeg" class="attachment-medium size-medium wp-image-23353" alt="All-inclusive Snowkite Camp Fagerheim, Norway"/></div></div></div></div></div></section>
<section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-79f2fea elementor-hidden-desktop elementor-hidden-tablet elementor-hidden-mobile elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="79f2fea" data-element_type="section">
<div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default">

<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-7ac4b1d elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="7ac4b1d" data-element_type="widget" id="service" data-widget_type="heading.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <h4 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">We provide full snowkiting service</h4></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-59feab1 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="59feab1" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <p>The tour is designed to be as comfortable as possible for you. All you have to do is to enjoy it &#8211; snowkiting at Fagerheim, the best snowkiting accommodation Norway far and wide.</p><p>Depending on the weather, you can kite directly from the base every morning in any direction you prefer. Or <strong>we can drive you to any place</strong> of your preference within the plateau. It&#8217;s no exception that you end your day back at the base with a lovely experience of a whole day trip across multiple spots on the plateau covered purely with kites.</p></div></div></div></div></div></section>
<section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-5033dc6 elementor-hidden-desktop elementor-hidden-tablet elementor-hidden-mobile elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="5033dc6" data-element_type="section">

<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <h4 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Full board included</h4></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-544e56a elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="544e56a" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <p>After all-day kiting you certainly don&#8217;t want to spend evenings by the cooker, so we offer full board: <strong>breakfast, lunch to go, dinner.</strong></p><p>Breakfast table will be full of yummies (freshly baked bread, mixed eggs, sausages, butter, ham and cheese, müsli, yoghurts, coffee, tea, milk &#8230;).</p><p>For dinner we serve a variety of dishes of global cuisine.</p><p>The week starts by Saturday dinner and ends by Saturday breakfast. We try to adapt to diets.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-bf4bd44" data-id="bf4bd44" data-element_type="column">

<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <h4 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Under the supervision of experienced arctic explorers</h4></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d972882 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="d972882" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <p>Throughout the whole stay, you will be guided by experienced explorers who are coming to the area since 2010 and know it like home backyard.</p><p>They will recommend you the best spots for the day and your skills. They can drive you there if you want to. And they will watch after you.</p><p><strong>Stay with members of Jan Simek&#8217;s team, the Long Distance Kiting VAKE 2019 world champion.</strong></p></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-9d5bc39 elementor-button-success elementor-align-center elementor-widget elementor-widget-button" data-id="9d5bc39" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="button.default">

<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <h4 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">It doesn't have to end with kiting!</h4></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-6177fab elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="6177fab" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <p>Depending on the weather and your shape, you can go on <strong>a multi-day trip</strong> with sleeping in a tent, in the snow-shelter, or in one of the accessible cabins (we will rent you the equipment). You can try to pull the pulk with the kite, <strong>cooking on and from the snow</strong>, or dressing a frozen and sometimes snowy ski boots in the morning.</p><p>To liven up, we can rent a cross-country skis, there are great ski slopes around, or you can go snowshoeing or dog sledding&#8230; and not only children will certainly appreciate sledding on the slope, which we have only for ourselves. Pure happiness and experience for the rest of your life!</p></div></div></div></div><div class="elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-a65eb36" data-id="a65eb36" data-element_type="column">

<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <p>See the prices for additional luggage &#8211; except for ski boots you can borrow the rest of the equipment from us.</p><p><strong>Fly to Oslo airport</strong> &#8211; Gardemoen, Torp or Rygge.</p><p>In Oslo at the airport:</p><ul><li>rent a car and come directly to our base</li><li><strong>take a train to Haugastøl station</strong> (where we will pick you up) &#8211; reserve you train tickets via <a href="https://www.vy.no/en" target="_blank" rel="noopener">VY.no</a></li><li><span class="HwtZe" lang="en"><span class="jCAhz ChMk0b"><span class="ryNqvb">on some dates, we can arrange transport from/to the airport in Oslo (must be agreed in advance).<br /></span></span></span></li></ul><p>Welcome to Fagerheim, the best snowkiting Norway accommodation!</p></div></div></div></div><div class="elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-inner-column elementor-element elementor-element-8cc0741" data-id="8cc0741" data-element_type="column">

<div class="elementor-widget-container"> <p>In our opinion, this is the best way to get here, even with smaller (2+) groups of people. You can take any equipment and supplies with you, and have much fun with your friends during the road trip.</p><p><strong>Just drive!<br /></strong></p><p><strong>Recommended ferries</strong> when coming from central Europe:</p><ul><li>Hirtshals &#8211; Larvik (<a href="http://www.colorline.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">www.colorline.com</a>)</li><li>Hirtshals &#8211; Langesund (<a href="http://www.fjordline.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">www.fjordline.com</a>)</li><li>Rostock &#8211; Trelleborg (<a href="http://www.stenaline.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">www.stenaline.com</a>)</li></ul></div></div></div></div></div></section></div></div></div></section>
